definitions.all_failure: This arm after_constraints.has_success is exactly false; pair/full eligibility are separate.
definitions.delta: saved selected error minus saved comparator error; original float subtraction, strict >0/<0/==0; no new tolerance
definitions.comparable: actual pose present and available, saved metric pose_available, finite numeric error on both sides
definitions.either: T and R both comparable; logical OR of strictly positive/negative deltas; tradeoffs may be both worseEither and improvedEither
definitions.moments: Signed deltas; empty comparison or sign subset has n=0 and sum/mean/min/max=null, never a manufactured zero.
definitions.nonfinite: Raw NaN/+Infinity/-Infinity preserved as text in CSV; exclusion reasons and null aggregates explicitly counted.
definitions.population: CSV contains one row per qualifying frame/arm/comparator, without duplicating PRIMARY/subpopulation views.
definitions.inference: Descriptive post-seal diagnosis only; no new policy, seed choice, calibrated safety guarantee or validation score.
